executiveSummary: The tech industry is shifting towards sustainability, with Amazon's data centers being a major concern for climate change. Apple is also focusing on energy efficiency with its upcoming products and services, while AI/ML developments are becoming more prevalent in the industry.

takeaways.title: Sustainability Concerns
takeaways.description: Amazon's new data center could become the biggest polluter in the US if not managed properly. Apple is also working on energy-efficient products and services to reduce its carbon footprint.

takeaways.title: Energy Efficiency
takeaways.description: Apple is skipping some M6 Pro chips to accelerate development of more efficient M7 chip, which could lead to better battery life for users.

worthWatching: Amazon's data center investments may have significant environmental impacts if not managed responsibly.
Apple's focus on energy efficiency could lead to better battery life and reduced carbon footprint for users.
engineeringPerspective: The shift towards AI/ML will require significant updates to software development frameworks and algorithms to handle large datasets and complex models.
Supply chain management is crucial in the tech industry, as delays or inefficiencies can have a ripple effect on product availability and pricing.
